name: P-H-C/phc-winner-argon2
description: The reference C implementation of Argon2, the Password Hashing Competition winner and recommended password-hashing function. Provides Argon2i, Argon2d, and Argon2id variants for secure password storage and key derivation.
score_rationale: The authoritative reference implementation of the industry-recommended password hashing algorithm with 5.2k stars, though development has slowed since 2019 as the algorithm is considered stable.
